tools.name: find_symptom_words
tools.description: Organises a non-identifying, user-authored sensation description into neutral sensation, timing, pattern and impact vocabulary. Requires explicit consent for transient processing. PHI and diagnostic inference are outside its scope.

tools.name: build_health_timeline
tools.description: Sorts non-identifying, user-authored observations into a factual chronology while preserving supplied dates and uncertainty. Requires explicit consent for transient processing. PHI and diagnosis are outside its scope.

tools.name: prepare_appointment_brief
tools.description: Structures non-identifying goals, changes, impacts, user-stated medicines and questions into an appointment brief. Requires explicit consent for transient processing. PHI, diagnosis and treatment advice are outside its scope.

tools.name: reflect_on_flare
tools.description: Structures non-identifying before, during and recovery observations, presenting suspected patterns as questions rather than causes. Requires explicit consent for transient processing. PHI is outside its scope.

tools.name: render_appointment_brief
tools.description: Renders a supplied, complete, non-identifying appointment brief as an accessible card. Requires explicit consent for transient processing. Preserves the supplied fields and disclaimer; PHI is outside its scope.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_symptom_words" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "After explicit consent, organise only the user's non-identifying description into neutral sensation, timing, pattern, and impact vocabulary. Do not accept PHI or infer a diagnosis or cause." → after: "Organises a non-identifying, user-authored sensation description into neutral sensation, timing, pattern and impact vocabulary. Requires explicit consent for transient processing. PHI and diagnostic inference are outside its scope."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
